name: mcp-nexus
description: A multi-provider MCP server that acts as a unified bridge for Tavily, Brave Search, and GrokSearch APIs. It features a comprehensive Admin UI for managing API key rotation, client authentication, and real-time usage monitoring across all search providers.

rawRecord.description: A multi-provider MCP server that acts as a unified bridge for Tavily, Brave Search, and GrokSearch APIs. It features a comprehensive Admin UI for managing API key rotation, client authentication, and real-time usage monitoring across all search providers.

HOST.description: The host address for the server to listen on.

PORT.description: The port for the server to listen on.

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string for the database. For local setups, a file-based SQLite DB is recommended.

BRAVE_API_KEY.description: A single Brave Search API key. For multi-key support, use the Admin UI.

ADMIN_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for accessing the Admin API.

ENABLE_QUERY_AUTH.description: If true, enables MCP client token authentication for the /mcp endpoint.

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.description: Optional Firecrawl API key used for supplemental source/fetch fallback.

SEARCH_SOURCE_MODE.description: Defines search behavior: tavily_only, brave_only, combined, or brave_prefer_tavily_fallback.

GROK_SEARCH_ENABLED.description: Enables/disables Grok tool exposure (web_search, get_sources, etc.).

KEY_ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: A 32-byte (256-bit) secret key used for encrypting and decrypting upstream API keys stored in the database.

TAVILY_BRIDGE_BASE_URL.description: Deployment URL for the mcp-nexus bridge-server (used by stdio-http-bridge).

TAVILY_BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN.description: Client bearer token used for authenticate with the MCP endpoint (used by stdio-http-bridge).
